blocks.zh: Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: Original Text 原文內容
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: Tutorial Commentary 導師解析
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: ⟨1229⟩ 章節體系：USP ⟨1229⟩ 是滅菌的母章（parent chapter），涵蓋了蒸汽滅菌、乾熱滅菌、輻射滅菌、氣體除菌過濾、液體除菌過濾等主流方法。⟨1229.12⟩ 專門處理的是：當這些已確立的方法都不適用時，如何評估一個全新的滅菌技術。
blocks.en: The ⟨1229⟩ chapter family: USP ⟨1229⟩ is the parent chapter on sterilization, covering the mainstream methods: steam sterilization, dry heat sterilization, radiation sterilization, sterilizing-grade filtration of gases, and sterilizing-grade filtration of liquids. ⟨1229.12⟩ addresses a specific question: how to evaluate a completely new sterilization technology when none of these established methods is suitable.

blocks.zh: End User Responsibility：原文明確指出責任在終端使用者（end user）身上。這表示法規機關不會主動批准新滅菌技術，而是由製造商提出證據來說服法規機關接受。
blocks.en: End User Responsibility: The original text states clearly that the responsibility lies with the end user. In practice, regulators do not proactively approve new sterilization technologies; instead, the manufacturer must present evidence that persuades the regulator to accept the method.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 前瞻性文件：這是整個 ⟨1229⟩ 體系中最短、最具前瞻性的章節。它不描述任何具體的滅菌方法，而是提供一個「評估框架」——當未來出現新的滅菌技術（如超臨界 CO2、脈衝電場、微波滅菌等）時，提案者應遵循的路徑。
blocks.en: A forward-looking document: This is the shortest and most forward-looking chapter in the ⟨1229⟩ family. It does not describe any specific sterilization method; it provides an "evaluation framework", the path a proposer should follow when a new sterilization technology emerges (for example supercritical CO2, pulsed electric fields, or microwave sterilization).

blocks.zh: 與前面章節的關係：⟨1229.1⟩ 到 ⟨1229.11⟩ 各自描述一種已確立的滅菌方法；⟨1229.12⟩ 則是「安全網」——確保未來的創新技術有路徑進入藥典體系。
blocks.en: Relationship to the earlier chapters: ⟨1229.1⟩ through ⟨1229.11⟩ each describe one established sterilization method; ⟨1229.12⟩ is the "safety net", ensuring that future innovative technologies have a route into the compendial system.

blocks.zh: Points to Consider for a New Sterilization Method — 新滅菌方法的評估考量
blocks.en: Points to Consider for a New Sterilization Method

blocks.zh: 七步評估框架解析 Evaluation Framework
blocks.en: The Seven-Step Evaluation Framework

blocks.zh: 這七個步驟形成一個逻輯嚴謹的評估流程：
blocks.en: These seven steps form a logically rigorous evaluation process:

blocks.zh: 步驟 1 — 排除現有方法：必須先證明現有的滅菌方法（⟨1229.1⟩–⟨1229.11⟩）無法適用於該產品/材料。這是進入門檻。
blocks.en: Step 1 — Rule out existing methods: You must first demonstrate that the existing sterilization methods (⟨1229.1⟩–⟨1229.11⟩) cannot be applied to the product or material. This is the entry threshold.

blocks.zh: 步驟 2 — 文獻支持：收集所有支持該新方法的科學文獻。
blocks.en: Step 2 — Literature support: Collect all the scientific literature that supports the new method.

blocks.zh: 步驟 3 — 廣譜致死性：必須證明對多種微生物（包括縘孢形成菌）具有可重現的殺滅效果。
blocks.en: Step 3 — Broad-spectrum lethality: You must demonstrate reproducible kill across a variety of microorganisms, including spore-forming organisms.

blocks.zh: 步驟 4 — CPP 識別：找出關鍵製程參數（時間、溫度、濃度、能量、濕度），並包含陽性/陰性對照。
blocks.en: Step 4 — CPP identification: Identify the critical process parameters (time, temperature, concentration, energy, humidity), and include positive and negative controls.

blocks.zh: 步驟 5 — BI 選擇：挑選對該方法具有高抗性的生物指示劑。
blocks.en: Step 5 — BI selection: Select a biological indicator that is highly resistant to the method.

blocks.zh: 步驟 6 — Bioburden 比較：比較實際生物負荷與 BI 的相對抗性。
blocks.en: Step 6 — Bioburden comparison: Compare the resistance of the actual bioburden with that of the BI.

blocks.zh: 步驟 7 — 確認監測：建立可靠的製程中/製程後確認方法。
blocks.en: Step 7 — Confirmation monitoring: Establish a reliable in-process or post-process confirmation method.

blocks.zh: 法規先行原則：原文最後一段是關鍵訊息 — 對於人用或獸用產品，必須在臨床使用前取得法規機關的接受（acceptance），並在商業化前完成驗證（validation）。這不是建議，而是強制要求。
blocks.en: Regulatory-first principle: The last paragraph of the original text carries the key message: for human or veterinary products, regulatory acceptance must be obtained before clinical use, and validation must be completed before commercialization. This is not a recommendation but a mandatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 陽性/陰性對照的重要性：第四點特別強調需要陽性與陰性對照，以確認是新方法本身造成微生物死亡，而非其他因素（如自然衰亡或培養基中的抑菌成分）。
blocks.en: Importance of positive and negative controls: Point 4 specifically stresses the need for positive and negative controls, to confirm that the microbial kill is caused by the new method itself and not by other factors (such as natural die-off or bacteriostatic components in the culture medium).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 新藥上市的類比：想像一家藥廠要將一種全新的藥物推向市場。你不能直接賣 — 你必須：先證明現有藥物不夠用（步驟1）、找支持文獻（步驟2）、證明安全有效（步驟3-6）、建立監測機制（步驟7），然後與法規機關溝通後才能上市。這個流程與新滅菌方法的評估套路如出一轄。
blocks.en: The new drug analogy: Imagine a pharmaceutical company bringing a completely new drug to market. You cannot simply sell it. You must first show that existing drugs are insufficient (Step 1), find supporting literature (Step 2), demonstrate safety and efficacy (Steps 3-6), and establish a monitoring mechanism (Step 7); only after engaging with the regulator can you go to market. This is the same pattern as the evaluation of a new sterilization method.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1229.12⟩ 定位：整個 ⟨1229⟩ 體系中最短的章節，僅一頁。提供新滅菌技術的評估框架，而非具體方法描述。
blocks.en: Positioning of USP ⟨1229.12⟩: The shortest chapter in the ⟨1229⟩ family, only one page. It provides an evaluation framework for new sterilization technologies rather than descriptions of specific methods.

blocks.zh: 前提條件：必須先證明現有已確立的滅菌方法（⟨1229.1⟩–⟨1229.11⟩）無法適用，才能提議新方法。
blocks.en: Prerequisite: You must first demonstrate that the established sterilization methods (⟨1229.1⟩–⟨1229.11⟩) are not applicable before a new method can be proposed.

blocks.zh: 七步評估框架：排除現有方法 → 文獻回顧 → 廣譜致死性驗證 → CPP 識別 → BI 選擇 → Bioburden 比較 → 監測確認
blocks.en: Seven-step evaluation framework: rule out existing methods → literature review → broad-spectrum lethality demonstration → CPP identification → BI selection → bioburden comparison → confirmation monitoring

blocks.zh: 法規要求：人用/獸用產品必須在臨床使用前取得法規機關接受，商業化前完成驗證
blocks.en: Regulatory requirement: For human or veterinary products, regulatory acceptance must be obtained before clinical use, and validation completed before commercialization.

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬：舉證責任在終端使用者（end user），而非法規機關
blocks.en: Allocation of responsibility: The burden of proof rests with the end user, not the regulator.
